Author: dregan234
Name: Scribe's Prism
Description: A private development plugin that recolors chat lines sent by your macros. Write <white>, <green>, <red>, <blue>, <yellow>, <purple>, <orange> or <#RRGGBB> tags in your macro text and see them rendered in color in your own chat log. The coloring is local to your client; other players still see the literal tag text.
